artifact: GRENDEL BC4 dark-scalar sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: full-grid rerun of 2026-07-12 (run locally by FLR): extends the mass grid below the dimuon threshold (0.14-0.20 GeV, S -> e e only; see production.py MASS_GRID note), 600k-event pool, 86 mass points. Pre-existing rows shift at MC-noise level (per-mass seeds are positional: rng(1000+i)).
correction: Supersedes the 2026-07-02 pre-fix run (deepest 7.1e-12, span 0.22-3.8 GeV): with daughter beta = p/E in the timing chi2 the lower edge is ~4% shallower (consistent with the HNL beta-fix median) and the 3.80 GeV point drops below N = 3, so the span ends at 3.70 GeV.

hypothesis.model: PBC BC4: Higgs-portal dark scalar, mixing only (no quartic)

physics_inputs.production: inclusive b -> X_s S (Winkler arXiv:1809.01876 eq. A7) summed over B+, B0, Bs; FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO); two-body B -> K S recoil
physics_inputs.decays: Winkler dispersive hadronic widths (digitized Fig. 4) below 2 GeV, perturbative spectator above; analytic leptonic widths

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reco + PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E)

column_contract.u2_min: lower sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island
column_contract.u2_max: upper sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3)
column_contract.ctau_sin2th1_m: scalar ctau at sin^2 theta = 1, metres

closure_note: The deepest point sits at the f0(980) width peak (~0.98 GeV), where the dispersive hadronic width is largest and the long-lifetime lower edge (proportional to 1/sqrt(Gamma_total)) is correspondingly deepest. The island ends at 3.7 GeV, below the m_B - m_K ~ 4.8 GeV endpoint: the inclusive b -> X_s S rate falls too rapidly as m_S -> m_B to retain N >= 3 at any mixing.
